generator: OpenAI built-in image generation, through the owner's ChatGPT account in the Codex CLI (codex exec, one non-interactive session per image)

session.styleReference: public/ui/auras/stomp_stun.webp, upscaled to 512px and attached to every session
session.promptShape: The house style brief, then the ability's name, what it does in the fight (its live journal summary), the painting subject and the element palette; square, one subject, no text, no border, no UI frame.

review: Every output was looked at full size and at 40px before it was accepted; a rejected output was regenerated with the reason folded into its prompt.

rejected.reason: at 40 px it read as a muddle of grey cloud: the healing, the point of the cast, did not show
rejected.retrySubject: a small storm-cloud spirit with a torn, ragged body, bright mint-green healing light flowing into it in soft ribbons and knitting its torn cloud back together, the mending glow clearly at the centre

rejected.reason: it repeated Wellspring Overflow (concentric fire rings round the wellspring): the two icons would read the same
rejected.retrySubject: three straight walls of white-gold fire bursting up out of cracks in a black basalt floor one after another, the nearest wall roaring tall, the middle one just igniting, the farthest still a glowing crack, seen low across the floor

rejected.reason: at 40 px it read as a field of fire: the two players struck by the cinders were lost in the flames
rejected.retrySubject: an armoured adventurer seen from above raising a shield as two white-gold cinders plunge straight down onto them out of a black sky, long fire trails behind the cinders

rejected.reason: the creatures dissolved into the flames: at 40 px it was an orange muddle with no readable shape
rejected.retrySubject: two small hunched molten imps of cracked basalt and glowing lava crawling on all fours across a dark floor toward a bright white-gold wellspring glowing behind them

rejected.reason: the fist, the shield and the element mark tangled together: at 40 px nothing read
rejected.retrySubject: a massive stone fist crashing into a tank's raised steel shield, a single glowing element rune of flame branded onto the shield's face where it struck

rejected.reason: the second try was again a grey cloud with a mint glow: still no readable heal at 40 px
rejected.retrySubject: a hooded storm caster raising both hands and channelling a ribbon of soft mint-green healing wind into a wounded ally beside it, bright green healing motes rising where the wind touches

reuseRejudged.reason: a carved tablet reads as a memorial, not the survivor raging and hastened by its partner's soul
a fire rune on basalt shows the mark the Wellkeepers cast, not the two adds that rise and must be tanked
a bursting coal is the Live Coal debuff, not the Splinter dragged across the floor leaving its Cinder Trail

the debuff's flat hand-authored snowflake is off the painted house style; the journal gets a painted ice snowflake that keeps the debuff's read (no gauntlet, which read as a hand in the 2026-11-25 playtest)

encoding.webp: quality 76, stepping down by 4 until the file is at or under 6144 bytes, effort 6, smart subsample
